name: loopx-workflow
description: LoopX AI-Native long-running task workflow for coding and automated delivery

scripts.typecheck: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); fs.accessSync("docs/design/coding-workflow-tools-spec.md"); console.log("Specs and interface definitions valid.");'
scripts.lint: bash -n scripts/*.sh && bash -n scripts/git-hooks/* && if [ -d bin ]; then bash -n bin/*; fi
scripts.build: chmod +x scripts/*.sh && chmod +x scripts/git-hooks/* && if [ -d bin ]; then chmod +x bin/*; fi && echo 'Build verification passed.'
